authority: PI, 2026-09-04, resolving an ambiguity inside DECISION_LEVERAGE_DIAGNOSTIC_SPEC.json after the power count was known. The resolution was made explicitly and is recorded here rather than applied silently.
rule: APPEND, not an edit. No sampling size, eligibility filter, horizon, seed or quantity changes. Only the conflict between two frozen clauses is resolved.

THE_CONFLICT.clause_A_sampling_rule: 'If a cell has fewer than 10 eligible steps, take all of them and record the shortfall.' -- says PROCEED
THE_CONFLICT.clause_B_reading_row_3: 'very few eligible mismatch states are found at all -> the diagnostic is underpowered rather than negative, and no conclusion about leverage is drawn.' -- says STOP
THE_CONFLICT.why_it_mattered_here: the shortfall is not uniform. z0 cells can supply the preregistered 10 (13 and 16 eligible); z1 cells cannot (4 and 2). Whether that constitutes 'very few' is a judgment that must not be made silently after seeing counts.

RESOLUTION.decision: clause A governs. Branch all four cells, taking all eligible mismatch states where a cell falls short, and record the shortfall explicitly.
RESOLUTION.clause_B_still_binds_the_INTERPRETATION: the z1 arms carry almost no statistical weight (4 and 2 points). No leverage conclusion may be drawn for z1 from this diagnostic in either direction. Reading row 3 applies to z1 specifically even though the branches are run.
RESOLUTION.what_z0_can_support: z0@A and z0@B meet the preregistered sample size and may be read normally, under the licensed-reading constraint in DLD_TERMINOLOGY_AND_LICENSED_READING_AMENDMENT.json.

EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_ALTERNATIVE.option: widening the >=40-steps-remaining eligibility filter to recover additional states
EXPLICITLY_REJECTED_ALTERNATIVE.why_rejected: changing a frozen filter after seeing the counts is precisely the move the seed-reuse rationale in DLD_TEACHER_MATCHING_CLARIFICATION_AMENDMENT.json forbade. The filter stays exactly as frozen. It cost z0@A 1 state, z0@B 4, z1@A 0 and z1@B 1 -- recovering them would not have changed z1's power situation anyway.

THE_FINDING_THAT_MOTIVATES_CAUTION.why_that_matters: z1 reproduces pi_B's macro commitments at ~99.8% fidelity in BOTH deployment conditions, yet z1 carries Pole B where the sealed eval measured V(z1,B)=0.4688 against specialist pi_B's own 0.625 on that pole (different seed blocks; descriptive comparison only). Whatever costs z1 its margin is not macro decision choice -- there are barely any macro decisions to blame. The branching pass cannot resolve this for z1, and is not expected to.
THE_FINDING_THAT_MOTIVATES_CAUTION.carried_forward: this points toward the non-macro candidates already named in DLD_TEACHER_MATCHING_CLARIFICATION_AMENDMENT.json#ANTICIPATED_OUTCOME -- target-head selection, accumulated action-detail differences, representational effects -- each requiring its own preregistration.

IMPLEMENTATION_CORRECTION_REQUIRED_BEFOR: experiments/dld_pass2_branch.py was written against v1: it reads DLD_PASS1_RECORD.json and its pole-matched 'teacher_actions'/'mismatch' fields. Run unchanged against corrected data it would silently reintroduce the exact category error v2 was built to remove. It must be repointed at DLD_PASS1_RECORD_V2.json, at 'mismatch_latent', and at the LATENT-matched teacher array (teacher_A_actions for z0, teacher_B_actions for z1) BEFORE launch, not after.
